Get Best Model Indices by Metric and Group

Source: R/model_selection_helpers.R
get_best_model_idx.Rd

Get Best Model Indices by Metric and Group

Usage

get_best_model_idx(df, metric, group_cols = c("Model", "Engine"))

Arguments

df

A data frame containing model performance summaries.

metric

A single character string naming the column in `df` used to identify the best model.

group_cols

Character vector of column names used to define model groups before selecting the best metric value. Defaults to `c("Model", "Engine")`.

Value

Integer vector of row indices in `df` corresponding to the best model group or groups.
